name: mac-mini-discord-music-bot
description: Private Discord music bot for playing YouTube audio from a Mac mini.

scripts.setup:python: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/python -m ensurepip --upgrade && .venv/bin/python -m pip install 'pip==25.3' && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
